CustomField.description: File-type questions only. Set by the configurator once this question is attached to a Funding Opportunity: which of that Funding Opportunity's Document Checklist Items an uploaded answer corresponds to. Left blank, the uploaded file attaches directly to the Application Form instead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Only used when the question's Data Type is File. Pick which of this Funding Opportunity's Document Checklist Items this question's uploaded file belongs to.
CustomField.label: Document Checklist Item
